response.sql: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share_of_total FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, o.observstation ASC LIMIT 10;
